dogecoin.text: Honestly, I think Dogecoin is like that goofy friend who accidentally ends up leading the party. Started as a joke, and now it’s everyone’s favorite crypto.
You know what’s funny? I never thought I’d be so into memecoins, but here we are... Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, and now all these new ones popping up. Crypto’s weird, but I’m here for it.
Every time I look at Dogecoin, I think, ‘How did a meme outgrow most startups?’ Guess it’s not just a coin; it’s a vibe.
